text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho. Tense from the 
immense pressure of proving her true 
worth, Daiichi Ruby is warmly sent off by 
K.S. Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer spotted Daitaku 
Helios and Mejiro Palmer in the stands, 
just as Daiichi Ruby's reputation came up 
in the surrounding chatter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the "Noble Clan," she is 
expected to match her mother's success. 
The Trainer was held responsible for those 
results, but was fully prepared to 
shoulder the burden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby seemed more nervous than 
usual. Though she claimed there was no 
issue, to the Trainer, it looked as if she 
was trying to hypnotize herself into 
believing it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer encouraged her to believe in 
the family bloodline flowing through her. 
Regaining her confidence, Daiichi Ruby's 
flower was now ready to bloom—
